#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int h, n;
    std::cin >> h >> n;
    int num = n - 1;
    std::string binary_str;
    while (num > 0) {
        binary_str += (num % 2 == 0) ? '0' : '1';
        num /= 2;
    }
    std::reverse(binary_str.begin(), binary_str.end());
    while ((int)binary_str.size() < h) {
        binary_str = '0' + binary_str;
    }
    int result = 0;
    bool flip = true;
    for (int index = 0; index < h; ++index) {
        if (binary_str[index] == (flip ? '1' : '0')) {
            result += (int)pow(2, h - index);
        } else {
            flip = !flip;
            result += 1;
        }
    }
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
